memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Iron-deficiency anemia and osteoporosis.
Patient reports fatigue, mild dyspnea on exertion, and back pain. Exam: pallor, tender lumbar spine, otherwise normal.
Spirometry: FEV1 2.8 L (92% predicted), FVC 3.2 L, FEV1/FVC 0.88; unchanged.
Technique checked: not applicable (no inhaler).
Smoking: never.
Plan: check CBC, ferritin, MCV, calcium, vitamin D; start ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD, alendronate 70 mg weekly, calcium 500 mg BD with vitamin D3 800 IU; review in 6 weeks.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD
Alendronate 70 mg once weekly
Calcium carbonate 500 mg BD
Vitamin D3 800 IU OD

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Haemoglobin 9.2 g/dL (ref 12-16)
Serum ferritin 12 ng/mL (ref 30-300)
MCV 78 fL (ref 80-100)
Serum calcium 9.0 mg/dL (ref 8.5-10.5)
Serum 25-OH vitamin D 18 ng/mL (ref 30-100)

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow-up appointment booked for 2025-05-10 at 10:00 with Dr Suresh Menon (D05).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Iron-deficiency anemia and osteoporosis.
Fatigue improved, constipation noted. Exam: mild pallor, no new back pain.
Spirometry: FEV1 2.8 L (92% pred), FVC 3.2 L, ratio 0.88; delta FEV1 0 L.
Technique checked: not applicable.
Smoking: never.
Assessment: Hb rising but still low; iron intolerance prompting dose change.
Plan: switch ferrous sulfate to 200 mg on alternate days; continue osteoporosis meds; recheck labs in 8 weeks.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Via clinic app: Feeling less tired but still some fatigue. Asking if I should increase vitamin D dose as my level still low.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Iron-deficiency anemia and osteoporosis.
Fatigue much better, occasional mild tiredness. Exam: no pallor, spine non-tender.
Spirometry: FEV1 2.9 L (95% pred), FVC 3.3 L, ratio 0.88; delta FEV1 +0.1 L.
Technique checked: not applicable.
Smoking: never.
Assessment: Anaemia improving; vitamin D still suboptimal.
Plan: increase vitamin D3 to 2000 IU daily; continue iron alternate days; repeat labs in 10 weeks.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Iron-deficiency anemia resolved; osteoporosis stable.
No fatigue, back pain mild. Exam: normal.
Spirometry: FEV1 2.9 L (95% pred), FVC 3.3 L, ratio 0.88; delta FEV1 0 L.
Technique checked: not applicable.
Smoking: never.
Assessment: Hb normal, ferritin adequate; vitamin D sufficient.
Plan: stop ferrous sulfate; continue alendronate weekly, calcium 500 mg BD with vitamin D3 1000 IU maintenance; review in 6 months.
